senses.gloss:
पौंसवन n. (-नं)
 1. One of the Sanskāras or essential ceremonies of the
Hindu religion; a religion; a religious observance held on a woman's perce-
iving the first signs of a living conception.
 2. fetus.
 3. milk. E.
पुंसवन, q. v., with अण् pleonastic aff.

पौनःपुनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Repeated, reiterated, again and again. E.
पुनर, again, repeated, aff. ठञ् ।

पौनःपुन्यं n. (-न्यं) Reiteration, repetition.
 E. पुनर् again, repeated, aff. यञ् ।

पौनरुक्त n. (-क्तं)
 1. Tautology.
 2. Superfluity, uselessness.
 E. पुनरुक्त, and
अण् added.

पौनर्भव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Repeated, additional.
 m. (-वः)
 1. The son of a
widow remarried, one of the twelve sons or heirs admitted by the
old Hindu law; the son of a twice-married woman.
 2. The second
husband of a woman.
 E. पुनर्भव, aff. अण् ।
